Bring the state and the archive up to the WAL tip, as a crash left them

Usage: dolos sync recover [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --discard-wal      When the WAL cannot bring the stores to its tip, reset it to the state
                         cursor instead, losing its rollback history
      --dry-run          Print what recovery would do, and change nothing
      --format <FORMAT>  How to print the result: text for people, JSON for scripts [default: text]
                         [possible values: text, json]
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
